newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Computer Forms stock suspended - KLSE.
newsitem.headline: Computer Forms stock suspended - KLSE.

text.p: The stock of Computer Forms (M) Bhd was suspended from trading on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Friday afternoon, said an exchange official.
The suspension was requested by the company pending a news announcement, she said.
Computer Forms is a maker and distributor of computer paper products and security documents, and is listed on the Second Board of the exchange.
The stock was up 70 cents to 18.30 ringgit in the morning session on Friday before its suspension.
